nodes.label: CachedDataHandler
nodes.rationale: Client-side cache of TOC data; server force-recalculates and sends it to requesting clients.

nodes.label: DataController
nodes.rationale: Server-side per-player TOC state holder. Created by the server on client join, seeded from previous moddata if any, then synced to the client through GlobalModData. Open question in notes: whether it should be keyed by username or playernum.

nodes.label: Model: prostheticArm (ground display)
nodes.rationale: WorldStaticModel shown for the Normal (Arm) Prosthesis.

nodes.label: Recipe: Craft Prosthetic Arm
nodes.rationale: Requires MetalWelding 4 and 4 MetalPipes + 2 Planks + BlowTorch + WeldingRods: the higher-tier, fully functional prosthetic.

nodes.label: Recipe: Craft Prosthetic Hook
nodes.rationale: Cheaper alternative (MetalWelding 2, fewer pipes) but slower actions once equipped.

nodes.label: Amputation (core mechanic)
nodes.rationale: Cut off the infected limb with a Saw/Garden Saw to survive the bite. Bandages/stitches auto-used to raise survival odds; a tourniquet placed on the correct side dampens post-amputation damage. Amputating the upper arm prevents equipping any prosthesis. Player gains skill points for the amputated side, making timed actions faster.

nodes.label: Cicatrization (wound healing)
nodes.rationale: Amputated limbs cicatrize over time; visible in the Health Panel. Wounds should be cleaned with a bandage to help the process. An incompletely cicatrized limb can still take a prosthesis but risks random bleedings.

nodes.label: Prosthesis (replacement limbs)
nodes.rationale: Two types (Hook and Arm) restore missing-hand functionality like two-handed weapons. Hook Prosthesis makes actions take longer but is cheaper to craft; equipping a prosthetic slowly builds familiarity (Prosthesis perk) that speeds actions.

nodes.label: README (The Only Cure)
nodes.rationale: This version was rebuilt from scratch to support future additions and to feel as close as possible to a vanilla mechanic. Supports Single Player and Multiplayer. Intended to be used with Fancy Handwork and Brutal Handwork mods.
